verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own product page says users can assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request, then refine, approve and merge it in the app. Agent Tasks for starting and tracking Copilot cloud agent work and the GitHub docs' issue-to-agent-to-PR flow back this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile flow, and in-depth mobile-specific documentation beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can assign an issue to an AI coding agent and receive a ready-to-review pull request

citations.quote: Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.
Agent Tasks are now on GitHub Mobile, giving developers a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks wherever they are.
A change can start as an issue, be picked up by an agent, return as a pull request, get reviewed for quality and security, and be merged.
